cyoa-application/src/generation.rs.name: Story generation use cases
cyoa-application/src/generation.rs.description: Orchestrates typed generation and returns an unchanged game with evidence when a turn fails.

cyoa-application/src/runtime.rs.name: Session effect driver
cyoa-application/src/runtime.rs.description: Dispatches typed intent and polls execution results without exposing mutable canonical state.

cyoa-application/src/session.rs.name: Canonical story lifecycle
cyoa-application/src/session.rs.description: Owns accepted game state and rejects stale or duplicate generation completions before they can change it.
